expressions.en: How are you? / How's it going?
Please (e.g., 'Please help me', 'Please pass the water')
How can I help? / May I assist you?
expressions.cn: 我可以怎么帮忙？/ 我可以为您服务吗？
expressions.bm_formal: Bagaimana boleh saya bantu? / Ada apa yang boleh saya bantu?
expressions.bm_casual: Ada apa? / Nak apa? / Boleh saya tolong?

work.scenario: You're at a new project meeting with colleagues from different departments. You want to greet them, offer help, and confirm understanding of the tasks.
key_phrases: Bagaimana boleh saya bantu dalam projek ini?
Saya faham apa yang perlu dilakukan.

life.scenario: You're at a local 'mamak' stall, trying to get the waiter's attention, ordering food, and thanking them.

tech.scenario: Your internet isn't working, and you're talking to a customer service representative or a tech-savvy friend.
key_phrases: Ada apa lagi yang boleh saya cuba?
